text: The undo transaction records message IDs before an undo or redo copy, listens on the destination folder, then uses OnMessageAdded to find the newly assigned keys. m_undoing chooses the source or destination key array. The listener is removed after the expected number of matching headers arrives. Reusing the old local keys after a new copy would not describe the new headers. This mechanism assumes matching message IDs and completion notifications; this study did not prove failure cleanup or duplicate-ID behavior. This note is based on source inspection. Tests were not run, and full review discussion remains pending.
title: Refresh copied message keys through destination notifications
